_comment: List YOUR OWN demos here. Each entry becomes a card under 'Your demos' on the Demos page. The one entry below ('Starter Template') is an EXAMPLE of what your card could look like. Delete it, copy demo/web/user/hello.html as a starting point for your real demo, and add YOUR entry here. Fields: title, path (required), description, capabilities, badge (optional).

demos.title: Starter Template
demos.description: The example page that shows how to call Arikizu capabilities from your own HTML. Three buttons, three capability calls, ~100 lines total. Copy demo/web/user/hello.html, rename it, and build your own app on top.
